eyebrow: One DAG, one task per table
code:
with DAG(
  dag_id='brightleaf_sql_server_to_snowflake',
  schedule_interval='0 1 * * *',
  catchup=False,
) as dag:

  extract_members >> trigger_dbt_run
  extract_memberships >> trigger_dbt_run
  extract_checkins >> trigger_dbt_run
